observations: Compound formula is C21H18O9 with molecular weight 414.37 g/mol.
Reported LogP is 0.15 and TPSA is 161.59 Å².
Structure contains multiple hydroxyl, ketone, ether, and methoxy groups, indicating high polarity and hydrogen-bonding capacity.
Property-based assessment indicates low passive blood-brain barrier penetration.

entities.name: Low BBB penetration
observations: A highly oxygenated tetracyclic quinone-type compound with MW 414.37, LogP 0.15, and TPSA 161.59 Å² is unlikely to efficiently cross the blood-brain barrier passively.
